judge.method: viewed the Chrome render plus 2x crops of detail regions; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a recognizable grey dolphin with a streamlined body, dorsal fin, and tail fluke.
requirements.note: The dolphin is a saturated teal blue (about RGB 124,196,215 on the flank, an 90-point red-to-blue spread), not grey.

requirements.text: Show a water surface below the dolphin with a large splash effect at the point where the dolphin has exited the water.
requirements.note: A water surface is drawn, but there is no splash at all - only flat wave arcs elsewhere in the sea.

requirements.text: Position the dolphin in a dynamic jumping arc, with its entire body in mid-air.
requirements.note: The tail stock and both fluke lobes are drawn deep inside the blue water below the surface line, so the body is not entirely in mid-air.

requirements.text: Draw a circular, multi-colored hula hoop, and position the dolphin so its mid-section is passing through the center of the hoop.
Include a human trainer's arm and hand extending into the frame.
The trainer's hand must be holding a small fish by the tail.
requirements.note: The forked orange tail fin is at the far left of the fish and the head (eye and mouth line) is at the right, where the trainer's hand grips it; the fish is held by the head, not the tail.

requirements.text: The dolphin's mouth must be depicted as wide open, just about to bite the body of the fish being held by the trainer.
requirements.note: The dolphin's jaw is drawn closed, and the fish is held roughly 200px below and left of the snout rather than at the mouth.
